# Daily Mail Online

> UK news publisher covering breaking news, politics, showbiz, sport, lifestyle, money, travel, health, and opinion.

Daily Mail Online publishes reporting from the Daily Mail and Mail on Sunday, with dedicated sections for UK and world news, celebrity coverage, sport, finance, property, science, travel, and video.

## Main Editions
- [UK Home](https://www.dailymail.co.uk/home/index.html): Main UK homepage with top stories, breaking news, and featured coverage.
- [US Home](https://www.dailymail.co.uk/ushome/index.html): US edition homepage with American news, entertainment, and lifestyle coverage.
- [Australia Home](https://www.dailymail.co.uk/auhome/index.html): Australia edition homepage with regional and international news coverage.

## News
- [Home](https://www.dailymail.co.uk/home/index.html): Front page aggregating major stories across news, sport, and entertainment.
- [News](https://www.dailymail.co.uk/news/index.html): UK and global breaking news, crime, politics, and current affairs.
- [World News](https://www.dailymail.co.uk/news/worldnews/index.html): International reporting on geopolitics, conflicts, disasters, and global events.
- [Politics](https://www.dailymail.co.uk/news/politics/index.html): UK political news, Westminster developments, policy, and election coverage.
- [Royal Family](https://www.dailymail.co.uk/news/royals/index.html): News and features on the British royal family and monarchy.
- [Crime](https://www.dailymail.co.uk/news/crime/index.html): Crime reporting, court cases, policing, and criminal investigations.
- [Science](https://www.dailymail.co.uk/sciencetech/index.html): Science and technology news, discoveries, space, and research updates.
- [Weather](https://www.dailymail.co.uk/news/weather/index.html): Forecasts, severe weather coverage, and climate-related news.

## Showbiz & Entertainment
- [TV & Showbiz](https://www.dailymail.co.uk/tvshowbiz/index.html): Celebrity news, entertainment reporting, red carpets, and television coverage.
- [Celebrities](https://www.dailymail.co.uk/tvshowbiz/celebrity-news/index.html): Latest celebrity stories, interviews, and paparazzi coverage.
- [Femail](https://www.dailymail.co.uk/femail/index.html): Lifestyle, relationships, fashion, beauty, and human-interest features.
- [Fashion Finder](https://www.dailymail.co.uk/femail/fashionfinder/index.html): Fashion shopping coverage and style inspiration tied to current trends.
- [Books](https://www.dailymail.co.uk/home/books/index.html): Book reviews, author features, and literary coverage.
- [Weekend](https://www.dailymail.co.uk/home/weekend/index.html): Features and culture content from the Weekend magazine section.

## Sport
- [Sport](https://www.dailymail.co.uk/sport/index.html): Comprehensive sports news, live coverage, analysis, and results.
- [Football](https://www.dailymail.co.uk/sport/football/index.html): Football news, transfer rumours, match reports, and league coverage.
- [Premier League](https://www.dailymail.co.uk/sport/teampages/premier-league.html): Premier League team pages, fixtures, standings, and related stories.
- [Tennis](https://www.dailymail.co.uk/sport/tennis/index.html): Tennis tournament coverage, player news, and match analysis.
- [Rugby](https://www.dailymail.co.uk/sport/rugbyunion/index.html): Rugby union news, fixtures, and competition reporting.
- [Cricket](https://www.dailymail.co.uk/sport/cricket/index.html): Cricket news, series coverage, commentary, and player updates.
- [Formula One](https://www.dailymail.co.uk/sport/formulaone/index.html): Formula One race coverage, driver news, and paddock analysis.

## Money & Property
- [Money](https://www.dailymail.co.uk/money/index.html): Personal finance, markets, savings, pensions, and consumer news.
- [Markets](https://www.dailymail.co.uk/money/markets/index.html): Stock market reporting, company news, and investment updates.
- [Pensions](https://www.dailymail.co.uk/money/pensions/index.html): Pension planning, retirement policy, and savings guidance.
- [Saving & Banking](https://www.dailymail.co.uk/money/saving/index.html): Savings accounts, banking news, and household money tips.
- [Mortgages & Home](https://www.dailymail.co.uk/money/mortgageshome/index.html): Mortgage rates, housing finance, and homeownership guidance.
- [Property](https://www.dailymail.co.uk/property/index.html): Property market news, homes coverage, and real estate features.

## Health & Lifestyle
- [Health](https://www.dailymail.co.uk/health/index.html): Medical news, wellness reporting, and public health coverage.
- [Diet & Fitness](https://www.dailymail.co.uk/health/diets/index.html): Diet trends, exercise advice, and weight-loss related features.
- [Travel](https://www.dailymail.co.uk/travel/index.html): Travel news, destination guides, aviation, and holiday inspiration.
- [Best Buys](https://www.dailymail.co.uk/best-buys/index.html): Product recommendations, shopping guides, and consumer-focused reviews.
- [You Magazine](https://www.dailymail.co.uk/home/you/index.html): Features on lifestyle, fashion, beauty, and interviews from You magazine.
- [Event for Change](https://www.dailymail.co.uk/home/eventforchange/index.html): Coverage focused on social impact, campaigns, and community initiatives.

## Opinion & Features
- [Debate](https://www.dailymail.co.uk/debate/index.html): Opinion columns, comment pieces, and editorial perspectives.
- [Columnists](https://www.dailymail.co.uk/debate/columnists/index.html): Index of regular Daily Mail opinion writers and commentators.
- [Most Read](https://www.dailymail.co.uk/home/mostread/index.html): Most-read stories across the site, updated by reader activity.
- [Latest Headlines](https://www.dailymail.co.uk/news/headlines/index.html): Continuously updated headline feed of recent published stories.
- [Newsletters](https://www.dailymail.co.uk/home/newsletter/index.html): Newsletter signup hub for Daily Mail editorial email products.

## Video & Media
- [Video](https://www.dailymail.co.uk/video/index.html): Video hub for news clips, interviews, entertainment, and viral footage.
- [MailOnline Videos](https://www.dailymail.co.uk/video/news/index.html): News-focused video coverage of current events and breaking stories.
- [TV & Showbiz Video](https://www.dailymail.co.uk/video/tvshowbiz/index.html): Entertainment and celebrity video clips, interviews, and event footage.
- [Sport Video](https://www.dailymail.co.uk/video/sport/index.html): Sports highlights, interviews, and match-related video coverage.
- [Travel Video](https://www.dailymail.co.uk/video/travel/index.html): Travel clips featuring destinations, transport, and holiday experiences.

## Puzzles & Games
- [Puzzles](https://www.dailymail.co.uk/puzzles/index.html): Hub for Daily Mail puzzles and interactive brain games.
- [Crosswords](https://www.dailymail.co.uk/puzzles/crossword/index.html): Crossword puzzle section with playable daily grids.
- [Sudoku](https://www.dailymail.co.uk/puzzles/sudoku/index.html): Daily Sudoku puzzles with varying difficulty levels.
- [Word Search](https://www.dailymail.co.uk/puzzles/wordsearch/index.html): Word search games and archive-style puzzle content.
